## Takahiro Morimoto

I work on world models and their applications to game testing at Mirai Yochi.
My goal is to build AI that can play games, recognize unexpected behavior, and help find bugs.

This blog documents experiments and implementation work: what I tried and what happened.
Alongside improvements, I want to record unchanged results and approaches that did not work.
